flow: ElevenLabs flow 'The Twelfth Stamp - scary country audio' (UPMslwSRSs5TKr7Gt6Ho)
note: Prompts and settings exactly as generated (one take each). Ambience ids replace the synthesized beds of the same id; scare ids are new one-shots played by AmbientScares.

amb_egypt.prompt: Oppressive horror soundscape in a sealed Egyptian tomb, deep rumbling infrasonic drone, sand pouring from cracks, agonized human moans echoing off stone

amb_paris_rain.prompt: Horror soundscape, heavy rain on cobblestones at night, a woman sobbing and screaming far away through the downpour, slow church bell, deep dread drone

amb_ny_harbour.prompt: Horror soundscape at a foggy harbor at night, deep distorted foghorn, black water slapping rotting piers, chains dragging, distant tortured groans

amb_japan_night.prompt: Japanese horror soundscape at night, wind hissing through bamboo, slow distant temple bell, a woman's faint eerie wailing, wooden creaks, deep dread drone

amb_riyadh_wind.prompt: Horror sandstorm at night, violent howling wind, sand hissing against glass, guttural inhuman growls buried in the wind, deep rumbling drone

amb_india_garden.prompt: Horror night garden by black still water, insects falling silent, distant peacock screams, wet dripping, low droning human moans

amb_rio_frozen.prompt: Horror soundscape of a frozen dead carnival street, one slow heavy drum beat far away, crowd screams stretched in slow motion, deep drone

amb_london_river.prompt: Horror soundscape by a foggy river at midnight, huge clock ticking slowly and loudly, water lapping stone, distant drowning gurgles, deep ominous drone

amb_berlin_hall.prompt: Horror soundscape in a vast abandoned concrete bunker, deep electrical hum, echoing drips, heavy doors slamming far away, metal scraping, faint screams below

amb_margin.prompt: Hellish void soundscape, deep pulsing infrasonic drone, distant reversed screams, metallic scraping, wet ragged breathing all around

amb_apartment_corrupt.prompt: Horror soundscape in a corrupted apartment, warped groaning air conditioner, walls creaking like they breathe, overlapping whispers, deep detuned drone

amb_shop.prompt: Unsettling old antique shop at night, many clocks ticking out of sync, wind rattling the door, floorboards creaking, low uneasy hum

amb_apartment.prompt: Unsettling apartment at night, air conditioner hum, distant city, slow wall creaks, a faint heavy thud somewhere in the building, low uneasy drone

scare_any_scream.prompt: Sudden blood-curdling female scream very close, raw terror

scare_any_growl.prompt: Deep guttural demonic growl right behind the listener, wet and close

scare_any_bones.prompt: Bones cracking and snapping slowly, close-mic, sickening crunch

scare_any_pound.prompt: Violent frantic pounding on a wooden door, then sudden silence

scare_any_breath.prompt: Heavy ragged breathing inches from the ear, ending in a low hiss

scare_any_giggle.prompt: Child giggling softly in an empty room, echoing

scare_shop_1.prompt: Single slow heavy footstep on old floorboards right behind, long creak

scare_shop_2.prompt: Many ticking clocks stopping at once, followed by one loud chime

scare_home_1.prompt: Three slow heavy knocks from inside a wall

scare_home_2.prompt: Door handle rattling violently in an empty hallway

scare_margin_1.prompt: Reversed whisper swelling louder and cut off sharply

scare_margin_2.prompt: Phone ring slowing down and pitching into a deep demonic groan

scare_egy_1.prompt: Heavy stone sarcophagus lid grinding open, deep scraping, dust falling

scare_egy_2.prompt: Dry rattling death exhale close to the ear, dusty lungs

scare_par_1.prompt: Woman's agonized scream echoing down a rainy stone alley

scare_par_2.prompt: Fast wet footsteps sprinting toward the listener, then stopping dead

scare_ny_1.prompt: Metal subway brakes screeching into a distorted human scream

scare_ny_2.prompt: Body slamming against a metal shipping container from inside, hollow boom

scare_jpn_1.prompt: Wooden sliding door slammed open violently

scare_jpn_2.prompt: Slow gurgling croak from a broken throat, close and wet

scare_sau_1.prompt: Large mirror cracking and shattering, sharp glass splinters

scare_sau_2.prompt: Deep inhuman voice moaning inside howling wind

scare_ind_1.prompt: Something heavy surfacing from still water, splashing and dripping

scare_ind_2.prompt: Peacock shriek warping into a human scream

scare_bra_1.prompt: One huge deep drum hit with a long dark echo

scare_bra_2.prompt: Crowd laughter slowing and warping into a deep demonic drone

scare_uk_1.prompt: Giant clock bell striking once, slowed and distorted, long echo

scare_uk_2.prompt: Drowning man gurgling and thrashing in water

scare_mor_1.prompt: Oud string snapping violently with a metallic twang

scare_mor_2.prompt: Hundreds of whispers rushing past the listener

scare_ger_1.prompt: Heavy steel blast door slamming in a concrete bunker, huge echo

scare_ger_2.prompt: Metal hook scraping slowly along a concrete wall
